name: ground-plains-v1
prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL production terrain texture sheet for a dark fantasy regional map rendered as fine pixel art. Square canvas. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows of SIXTEEN rectangular texture swatches, all cells FILLED EDGE TO EDGE, no gutters, no borders, no text. Each cell is a different usable variation of the same biome ground material. These are top-down flat ground textures, not landscapes, not islands, not scene vignettes, not freestanding sprite objects. No horizon, perspective blocks, detached shadows, buildings, large trees, tall mountains, roads or water. Antique fantasy atlas engraving translated to small deliberate pixel clusters, restrained weathered natural colours, directional fine marks, tactile ground detail at large/medium/fine scales. Consistent scale and diffuse upper-left lighting, no large lighting gradient or vignette across the sheet. Avoid obvious circular stamps and regular polka-dot speckles. These swatches will be imported at 32 pixels across and automatically joined into continuous terrain; each needs varied but readable material structure. Full opaque image.
BIOME: Ochre loam and dry grass country: weathered soil, straw, olive grass filaments, fine gravel, worn bare earth, dry shallow channels, stony soil, grassy hummocks drawn flat, exposed roots, dark fertile earth, pale dusty patches. Subdued parchment ochre, taupe, umber and olive; no glaring yellow. Vary the balance in every cell.

name: bank-plains-v1
prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL production bank-material atlas for a dark fantasy pixel-art regional terrain system. Landscape canvas. Exactly TWO columns and FOUR rows: EIGHT wide rectangular texture swatches filling every cell completely, without gutters, frames, text or labels. Every swatch is a flat TOP-DOWN terrain cross-section whose shoreline runs horizontally through the MIDDLE. Upper half: dry biome ground. Central quarter: a detailed irregular bank edge with stones, roots or low rock faces. Lower half: shallow water and submerged material. Waterline stays around the middle, with small natural meanders, not a diagonal scenic composition. Material extends all the way to the left and right edges of each swatch so it can continue sideways. No islands, no horizon, no perspective landscape scenes, no buildings, no decorative objects floating on a base, no giant trees or high mountains. Fine antique fantasy-map engraved/pixel-cluster aesthetic, weathered muted materials, consistent diffuse upper-left light, detailed ground-scale marks. These will be imported at 64 by 32 pixels and conformed to arbitrary coastlines and rivers. The artwork must describe the land meeting water as one continuous environment. FULL OPAQUE IMAGE.
BIOME PROFILES: Dry ochre loam and grass above the bank; crumbling soil, gravel and root ends in the bank; a broken pale sand/silt margin and cool muted teal shallow water below. Eight profiles vary sandy beach, gritty bank, low eroded ledge, root-bound bank, pebbled margin, sheltered muddy inlet, rough bank and broad sand shelf.
